title: Gemma 4 WebGPU attention performance evidence
scope: Gemma attention kernel changes only; matrix experiments are recorded as rejected or unproven.

claims.metricBoundary: For each input size, take the median of each request's summed kernel GPU timestamps, then the geometric mean across input sizes. This excludes CPU work, browser scheduling, IPC, readback, and model loading.

environment.amd: AMD Ryzen integrated graphics, RADV Mesa 25.2.8
environment.timing: WebGPU timestamp-query; two warmups, seven measured requests per E2B case, five for its baseline repeat, and five per E4B case. Focused attention benchmarks use three samples and one warmup.
environment.execution: GPU jobs serialized; VK_DRIVER_FILES selects the Vulkan ICD; software adapters rejected.

retainedChanges.title: parallelize Gemma attention keys
retainedChanges.description: Eight lanes cooperate on each key dot product, with 32 keys processed concurrently within each 128-key online-softmax tile. Output accumulators stay in registers.

retainedChanges.title: vectorize Gemma attention dot products
retainedChanges.description: For dimensions divisible by four, use vec4 f32 dot products; retain the scalar lane-stride fallback for other dimensions.

amdAttentionMicrobenchmark.note: Attention microbenchmark only. Full-model AMD correctness is recorded separately; no full-model AMD latency gain is claimed.

baseline.metric: geometric mean of per-case median Gemma 4 attention milliseconds

currentVectorAttention.metric: geometric mean of per-case median Gemma 4 attention milliseconds

rejectedCandidates.title: skip empty attention key groups

focused.metric: geometric mean of per-case median Gemma 4 attention milliseconds

rejectedCandidates.outcome: reverted; the saved E2B profile is slower than the retained vector-attention result.

rejectedCandidates.title: process 64 attention keys concurrently

focused.metric: geometric mean of per-case median Gemma 4 attention milliseconds

rejectedCandidates.outcome: reverted; four lanes per 64-key group did not beat the retained eight-lane layout in the saved E2B profile.

rejectedCandidates.title: reuse inputs across 128 matrix columns
rejectedCandidates.outcome: reverted; no shared matrix gain was proven. The groups=2 named-accumulator matrix microbench is slower geometrically than groups=1.

rejectedCandidates.title: multiply matrix tiles in packed half precision
rejectedCandidates.outcome: reverted; the packed-half matrix path was slower in the matrix scan and full E2B profile.

rejectedCandidates.title: share Gemma key tiles across eight queries

focused.metric: geometric mean of per-case median Gemma 4 attention milliseconds

rejectedCandidates.outcome: reverted after exploration; the saved profile is a provisional result for a separate f32 query-tile path and is not a retained production claim.
